mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO drops > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a monetary easing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances during a monetary easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 jobs in a month signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 300k jobs.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both increase by more than 5% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 5% MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month, it signals a tightening monetary policy with economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.
